lab.caption: An embryologist working at a microscope in an IVF laboratory.

embryo.caption: A real human embryo at the four-cell stage, photographed through a microscope.

icsi.caption: A sperm is injected into an egg during ICSI. This is NOT cytoplasmic transfer; it illustrates the scale of laboratory micromanipulation.

medications.caption: A photographed collection of IVF medications and supplies. Treatment regimens differ; this is not a prescribing guide.

oocyte.caption: A real human oocyte with its surrounding zona pellucida, photographed using a ZEISS microscope. This is an egg, not an embryo.

equipment.caption: Microscopes and workstations in an IVF laboratory. This photograph shows laboratory equipment, not egg or embryo cryostorage.
